name: Favorita Store 37 Weekly Sales
citation: Corporacion Favorita, and Kaggle. "Corporacion Favorita Grocery Sales Forecasting." Kaggle, 2017, www.kaggle.com/c/favorita-grocery-sales-forecasting.
license: Competition data - see Kaggle source (verify terms before redistribution); weather Open-Meteo/ERA5.
description:
Corporacion Favorita weekly UNIT SALES (Ecuador grocery), 2013-01-13 to 2017-08-13 (240 weeks, W-SUN). Series: store 37, Cuenca (type D). Target column renamed from 'target' to 'unit sales'. Covariates (7) are genuine exogenous known-future drivers (weather, macro, promotion) - none are calendar timestep columns.

Covariate glossary:
- unit sales (units): weekly total store unit sales (target).
- max temperature (degC): maximum daily air temperature, weekly mean (Open-Meteo/ERA5).
- min temperature (degC): minimum daily air temperature, weekly mean (Open-Meteo/ERA5).
- precipitation (mm): total daily precipitation, weekly mean (Open-Meteo/ERA5).
- wind speed (km/h): daily mean wind speed, weekly mean (Open-Meteo/ERA5).
- store transactions (count): per-store weekly receipts, a foot-traffic proxy.
- oil price (USD): Ecuador WTI oil price, a macro demand driver.
- promotion share (fraction): share of items on promotion that week.
preprocessing: 1. Source: Kaggle 'Corporacion Favorita Grocery Sales Forecasting' competition (2017); aggregated to weekly (W-SUN) unit sales.
2. Weather covariates (tmax, tmin, precip, wind) from Open-Meteo/ERA5, daily aggregated to the weekly grid.
3. Macro/promo covariates: Ecuador WTI oil price, per-store transactions (foot-traffic proxy), and promotion share.
4. No calendar columns were dropped because the wide input had none - all 7 covariates are genuine exogenous drivers.
5. Target column renamed from 'target' to 'unit sales'; target vs covariate roles are declared in task.yaml.
6. Long-form TempusBench schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps (JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings, shared across variates), values (JSON array; NaN serialized as null).
